MCTPBridgePoolDevice.description: Downstream Exposes type. One entry per bridge-downstream device; the configured_by anchor that mctpreactor's BridgePoolMCTPDevice consumer targets. The consumer computes bridgedEid = <bridge>.Bridge1.PoolStart + PoolIndex and publishes configured_by on that pool-member endpoint -> this object, so bridged devices look identical to direct devices to all consumers.

Name.description: Bridged device identity; matched by its PLDMFirmwareDevice.MCTPTargetName. This is what configured_by ultimately resolves to.

BridgeName.description: The sibling bridge's MCTPUSBDevice.Name. The consumer resolves it to the bridge's mctpd endpoint -> Bridge1.PoolStart.

PoolIndex.description: 0-based slot in the bridge's EID pool. bridgedEid = Bridge1.PoolStart + PoolIndex. Encodes the bridge-port-to-device wiring (fixed at PCB design).

title: MCTP Bridge Pool Device Exposes Record
description: Downstream entity-manager Exposes schema describing a bridge-downstream MCTP device as the configured_by anchor for mctpreactor's BridgePoolMCTPDevice consumer.
